target_name: Solvency Conjunction Net Of Accrual Penalty
rationale: The composite is internally consistent (higher non-cash earnings per dollar of claims is correctly subtracted) and stacks the archive's two most reliable alpha channels, but it is a fairly mechanical linear pairing of two existing signals whose accrual leg had a near-zero FMB slope and only 0.09 coverage, so the combination risks diluting the cross-sectional evidence and shrinking usable sample rather than genuinely widening the spread.

This is a legitimate measurement-quality test of the distress leg with the profitability leg held fixed, but wcap/lt and che/lct are strongly overlapping liquidity constructs, so the change is close to a cosmetic re-parameterization of the archived best performer and unlikely to move either statistic much.

The sign logic is coherent (high MAX-of-badness → underperformance) and the asset-scaled accrual wedge sensibly restores coverage, but the proposer should note MAX over complementary badness ranks is algebraically the sign-flip of a MIN-over-goodness conjunction, so the structural "novelty" is really just a new pair of legs inside the already-tested weakest-link form.

xsga/revt is close to an inverse-profitability sort, so the short leg is largely unprofitable levered firms (a repackaging of the profitability and distress-leverage anomalies), and the expected negative sign contradicts the published operating-leverage premium (Novy-Marx 2011), which finds high cost-structure intensity earning *higher* returns.

Internally inconsistent and near-degenerate: the hypothesis invokes *cash* taxes and loss-carryforward exhaustion but the expression uses total tax expense (txt, including deferrals), and txt/at is mechanically almost collinear with oiadp/at, so the MIN collapses toward a plain profitability sort rather than testing a new distress dimension.

Maturity concentration is a genuinely distinct hazard dimension not yet in the archive, the leg is well defined for low-debt firms, and holding the conjunctive structure fixed makes it a clean discriminating test of rollover risk versus debt level — though the maturity-structure literature means any result should be checked against existing short-term-debt pricing evidence.
